name: Florida 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a county 4-H club and pick projects such as gardening, animal science, STEM or public speaking. Teens can add events, camps and leadership roles.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 5 to 18. Your age is counted on September 1. You can also stay until you finish high school.
pay_detail: $20 per year for community club members ages 8 to 18. Some counties charge a different amount.
deadline_text: Enrollment for each 4-H year starts August 1. No closing date stated.
how_to_apply: Call your county Extension office. Then join online in 4-H Online. Paper forms are also available.
notes: State events include iLEAD and 4-H University Legislature Day at the Capitol. Florida has three 4-H camps: Cherry Lake, Cloverleaf and Timpoochee. You do not have to be a member to go to their summer camps.
